fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description:
Detects the command line executed when TeamViewer starts a session started by a remote host.
Once a connection has been started, an investigator can verify the connection details by viewing the "incoming_connections.txt" log file in the TeamViewer folder.
fields.name: Remote Access Tool - Team Viewer Session Started On Linux Host
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="linux" and (src.process.image.path contains "/TeamViewer_Service" and tgt.process.image.path contains "/TeamViewer_Desktop" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "/TeamViewer_Desktop --IPCport 5939 --Module 1"))
